priorRootFullBrowser.failedTest: M10 n-D result tables expose true row-major coordinates and 100-element pages
priorRootFullBrowser.observedDefect: Structured validation cloned immutable typed values on parent status/autosave renders. The new clone reset TypedSignalResult paging, so page 3 remained at 100 rows instead of the expected 56.
priorRootFullBrowser.correction: SignalResult memoizes validated values by the original immutable value; typed child pages remain stable on unrelated parent renders.

diagnosticContract: Resolve exact existing instance paths of rank 0..8, then the actual childNodeId; never silently select a same-name root node for stale paths.
Support controlled nested definitions and the currently selected Variant definition; own a copy of the diagnostic path.
Open the real child canvas, select and mark the real error node, and focus only after React Flow measurements match the view.

On a genuine while child reciprocal(0) failure, the browser sees NUMERIC_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, opens loop/bias, confirms the complete node bounding box lies in the canvas, repairs operation to square, and computes final result 4.
Old/stale/missing/overdeep locations leave the editor location intact and show a clear notice.
